description: Watch a JSON or REST endpoint where the response itself matters, not only that the host answered. Use it for health endpoints, webhooks and any API whose failure would be invisible to a plain page check. For an ordinary web page, create_http_monitor is lighter and enough.

name.description: Label shown in the dashboard and in alerts, up to 50 characters. Something recognisable months later beats the bare hostname.

url.description: Full endpoint URL including scheme, for example https://api.example.com/v1/status.

name: create_api_monitor

id.description: Monitor id, used by every other tool.

isActive.description: False while the monitor is paused.

statusSummary.description: Current state, for example GOOD or ERROR.

title: Create API monitor
